articles.title: North Korea conducts major weapons tests; South training ‘drone warriors’
articles.summary: North Korea recently conducted significant weapons tests to bolster its military and reinforce its southern border. This move comes amidst heightened tensions with South Korea, indicating a continued push by Pyongyang to strengthen its defence capabilities and assert its position in the region. The tests are part of an ongoing pattern of military provocations on the Korean Peninsula.

articles.title: He helped create India's first Made-in-India supersonic missile system: Meet Padma Shri awardee Dr Chandramouli Gaddamanugu, who started with two-member team in 1983 and went on to build Akash, that later starred in Op Sindoor
articles.summary: Dr. Chandramouli Gaddamanugu was a pivotal figure in developing the Akash, India's indigenous surface-to-air missile system. This achievement represents one of India's most significant advancements in defence technology, enhancing national security and self-reliance in missile development. His work underscores the importance of domestic innovation for strengthening India's military capabilities.

articles.title: Government officially names, for the first time, 6 Indian military personnel killed in Operation Sindoor
articles.summary: For the first time, the government officially disclosed the names of six Indian military personnel martyred during 'Operation Sindoor'. This cross-border military campaign was launched last May. The disclosure marks a significant step towards transparency regarding sensitive defence operations and acknowledges the sacrifices made by these soldiers, providing details previously withheld about the engagement.

articles.title: US FCC toughens submarine communication cable rules
articles.summary: The US Federal Communications Commission (FCC) has voted to tighten oversight on submarine communication cables, which carry 99% of global internet traffic. This move proposes new rules to enhance the security and regulation of these critical underwater data networks. For SSB aspirants, this underscores the growing strategic importance of international digital infrastructure and national security implications in a globally connected world.
